programmes.d: Vinnie tells Mel Profitt he is leaving to New Jersey, but Mel offers him the biggest cocaine distribution network in the country.
When Mel's former girlfriend shows up, begging for readmission to the inner circle, he uses her as a sexual pawn in a power game with a rival.
Vinnie retrieves secret records that enable Mel to blackmail a French official into buying munitions.
A beautiful San Francisco police detective aids Hunter and McCall in solving a series of puzzling murders apparently connected to the estate of a deceased millionaire.
Hunter and McCall search for a vengeful woman suspected of murdering two men involved in her sister's cocaine-related death.
Hunter and McCall try to protect their informant, Sporty James, from his own greed after he blackmails a ruthless cocaine dealer who's responsible for a murder.
Tony is stymied when identical twins both initially confess to the same murder, then, in a surprise about-face, accuse each other of the crime.
A serial killer has been mutilating the bodies of Eastbridge transients and homeless people — and Tony begins to suspect the perpetrator's identity.
During the holiday season, Tony investigates the murder of an elderly woman allegedly killed in her home during a Christmas burglary.

After Commissioner Scali's colleague, Chief of Detectives Irv Wallerstein, is struck down during a bloody encounter with hijackers, Tony becomes obsessed with finding the assailant.
A Vietnamese restaurant owner refuses help from the police against extortionists; Stan goes undercover to stop pizza-delivery muggings.
A mugging triggers a woman's repressed memory of her brother's murder which she witnessed as a child. The suspect is tracked to the unlikeliest of places by Tony and a visiting detective.
Small-time hood Aldo Baglia notices a photo of Vinnie in a newspaper and tracks him down — and shoots him for revenge.
When Mel Profitt's armaments deals go sour, he sends Vinnie back east to set up a narcotics import distribution deal with the mob.
After rejecting an offer to finance a coup d'etat in the Caribbean, Mel Profitt becomes obsessed with a supposed voodoo death curse.
Hunter and McCall's kidnapping-homicide investigation is thwarted by a rich industrialist who wants to control their methods of rescuing his abducted wife.
McCall masquerades as a nightclub singer to investigate the disappearance of a rock music star.
The malicious leader of a group of paramilitary neo-Nazis takes Hunter and McCall captive while the group plans their next attack.
After seeing his mother killed by a stranger, a boy withdraws deep into himself, prompting a sympathetic Tony to step up his efforts to catch the murderer.
